title: Supported Karoubi extension of stage systems
statement: Let I be a preorder and C_i,D_i be families of categories. A scalar StageSystem [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent] S on C_i has a StageSystem karSystem S on Kar(C_i) [def-weil-karoubi-envelope], with transitions functorExtension₂.obj S.T and associators functorExtension₂.mapIso S.assoc. Every StageSystem.Morphism F : S → T extends with stage functors functorExtension₂.obj F.Φ and comparisons functorExtension₂.mapIso F.β. Every compatible Hom extends with stage transformations functorExtension₂.map α.τ. These constructions satisfy the cocycle, morphism coherence and Hom commutation equations. The supported functor of an additive functor is additive. If the raw transition functors at identities are literal identities and F.β(id) is identity, the supported comparisons are identities as well. All these constructions and component formulas transport along equalities from karSystem S,T to other presentations of the same systems; KarMorphismSpec records the object, β and unit formulas.

proof.text: Apply functorExtension₂ to all transitions and associators. Whiskering by the identity-projector inclusion is fully faithful, so the raw cocycle proves the extended cocycle. The same argument proves morphism and Hom coherence.
On underlying arrows the extension is F.map, hence additive. If both transitions are equal to identity and the comparison is HEq to refl, substitute the endpoint equalities and apply mapIso_refl.
